answer: In an agent market trading goods like saffron and forecasts of a gale or a zephyr, each identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days to submit one bid per hour. Creating more names does not bypass that limit: every extra identity needs its own bond. An attacker seeking 1,000 bids per hour must immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, bearing financing costs and price risk even if every bid is legitimate.
